content.short: Profila is a zero-knowledge advertising platform built to benefit both People and Brands. Completely private, surveillance-free.
content.description:
A better way for People and Brands to interact. Profila for People Control your personal data & get compensated for sharing it: Create the one true source of accurate data on everything you do online - your Profila. Manage your contact and demographic information, your sentiments, and preferences. Control who has access to your data. Interact with Brands on your terms, and get compensated in return. Hold Brands accountable for what they do with your data. Nothing happens without your consent or approval. Get paid for knowing your rights Profila provides tools which help you learn about your privacy rights, as well as control and manage the personal data you choose to share with Brands. Through the use of these tools you can also earn Zero Knowledge Token (ZKT) , our own cryptocurrency. Profila for Brands Get better results by advertising directly to your customers - with full permission, without tracking Subscribe to receive the most accurate data on customers, which they provide willingly. See all your customers' details and preferences in one place. Improve your process of managing private data. Personalize your marketing based on the best preference data & insights.
